train_lm: train a KenLM language model from a corpus file using n-gram order and vocabulary size settings
sample: sample sentences from Common Crawl data based on perplexity scores relative to a trained language model
mine: mine sentences from Common Crawl shards that are similar to a given corpus using perplexity threshold filtering
normalize: normalize a corpus text file by applying text normalization rules and writing output to a directory
ExtractSentences: extract unique sentences from documents and score them with a language model using perplexity
